Chrome Cannon Glass — Codea project

Load on iPad:
1. Unzip so you have a folder named ChromeCannonGlass.codea
2. Open the Files app → On My iPad → Codea
3. Copy ChromeCannonGlass.codea into the Codea folder
4. Open Codea — the project appears on the home screen
5. Tap it → Play (landscape)

PLAY tab: drag to aim, FIRE (or Tab) to shoot, RESET to reload.
Black leather background (baked GPU texture). Neon tube type cycles slowly bright blue → pink → red.
Tabs: PLAY · SETTINGS · MIXER.
SETTINGS has two tabs: INPUT AUDIO (mic) and OUTPUT AUDIO (speaker).
Twist knobs on those tabs to set mic and speaker volume.
Sidebar NeonSpeed slows/speeds the tube color. GpuMegabytes shows the texture pool.
Sidebar Save / Load stores mixer volumes. Tweaking any fader resets screen glass.
